title: A piano demonstration: the odd bass note; learning piano from writing
summary: Gil plays a blues to show how an odd bass note creates tension and says he learned piano by writing music.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Now I know how distrubing it great is for people with/balance senses of hearing to play on pianos that may not necessarily be balanced. I'm just wondering if you wouldn't put it on tape here. Because people are going to be listening to this in year and years and year to come and may not necessarily have access to the albums at the time. And since your
own albums do not necessarily stress your own piano playing, is it an imposition upon you?
I learned to play the piano from writing music. I didn't pick it up at the piano. I got it from sitting there (thinking of all those things out I'd like to write for orchestration?).
Yes, I think a, in a long time somebody will be grateful if you'd do this.
